name: Zenigo Pro
tagline: Zenigo is free, and everything you need to find objects with your telescope stays free. Pro adds more for planning, for observing with a second device and for using Zenigo on all your devices.
terms: 12-month licence, paid once, no automatic renewal

features.title: Sync between devices
features.text: Your observing list, logbook and telescope settings on your phone, tablet and computer, end-to-end encrypted.

features.title: Live connection
features.text: A second phone or tablet follows the telescope: where it points, the way to the target and, if you like, the telescope’s camera image. Only the device on the telescope needs Pro; anyone can follow it.

features.title: Coming up
features.text: Eclipses, close pairs of the Moon and planets, oppositions, and meteor showers with how much the Moon will disturb them.

features.title: Satellites
features.text: The ISS and bright satellites on the map, and their next visible passes.

features.title: Eyepiece view and best eyepiece
features.text: The target as it looks in your eyepiece, and which of your eyepieces suits each object, with the reason.

features.title: Short route
features.text: Your planned objects in the order with the least turning for your mount, starting where the telescope points now.

features.title: Extended catalogue
features.text: About 13,000 galaxies, nebulae and clusters of the NGC and IC catalogues, and fainter stars.

features.title: Observing programmes
features.text: Lists such as the Messier and Caldwell objects, with your progress.

features.title: Logbook statistics
features.text: What you have seen, by night, object type and telescope, and more export formats.
